Faq.title: We've got answers.
Faq.description: Everything you need to know about the app. Didn't find the answer you were looking for? Contact our support team.

items.question: What databases does SQL Studio support?
items.answer: Currently, SQL Studio provides full support for SQLite databases. We are continuously evaluating support for other database systems based on user feedback and roadmap priorities.

items.question: What practice databases are included?
items.answer: SQL Studio comes with a catalog of pre-built databases covering common domains (e-commerce, banking, logistics, and more), each with its own schema and seed data, ready to query immediately. You can reset any of them back to their original state at any time.

items.question: Does SQL Studio need an internet connection?
items.answer: No. SQL Studio is offline-first: every database lives locally on your device, and the app doesn't need a network connection to work.

items.question: What languages does SQL Studio support?
items.answer: The app's interface is fully available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), and Spanish. You can switch between them from Settings.

items.question: Is SQL Studio available for iOS?
items.answer: Not yet. SQL Studio is currently available for Android only.

items.question: How do I get access to SQL Studio right now?
items.answer: SQL Studio is currently in closed beta on Google Play. Request access on our <downloadLink>download page</downloadLink>, and you'll get an invitation email once your account is approved as a tester.

items.question: Is SQL Studio open source?
items.answer: Yes. The app's source code is available on <githubLink>GitHub</githubLink> under the MIT license.

items.question: Is SQL Studio free?
items.answer: SQL Studio is completely free and offers all essential features at no additional cost. We believe in accessible tools for developers everywhere.

items.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
items.answer: You can open an issue on the app's <issuesLink>GitHub repository</issuesLink>, use the "Contact" item in the app's Settings, or reach us through our <contactLink>contact page</contactLink>.
